correctness.rationale: Independent reconstruction: the facet mixture pins one coordinate to a fair sign, giving diagonal second moment (d+2)/(3d). The kernel row mass is convex and invariant under sign changes, so a vertex norms it; continuity and full surface support make this an essential supremum. The sign row realizes the norm and symmetry gives L1 duality. The row law is 1+c_d(S_{d-1}+epsilon); integrating the simplex inclusion-exclusion CDF for the sum of k uniform [0,1] variables gives H_k with the stated 4/(k+1)! factor and the two rational benchmarks. For standardized S_k, the characteristic function expands as exp(-u^2/2)(1-u^4/(20k)+O((u^6+u^8)/k^2)) on |u|<=k^0.1, with Gaussian decay there and exponentially small integrated tails outside by the sinc bound. The absolute-moment integral gives relative +1/(20k); density inversion gives the stated O(k^-3/2) local error uniformly over bounded shifts. The two facet shifts contribute +5/(3d) on top of -49/(20d), giving -47/(60d); the volume shift adds 1/(6d) to 1/(20d), giving +13/(60d) and the claimed O(d^-3/2) gap error.
